content: 1. All individuals should be encouraged to adopt and maintain heart-healthy lifestyle habits, as these are foundational for reducing the risk of atherosclerotic cardiovascular disease (ASCVD). 2. The initiation or continuation of statin therapy should be tailored to the appropriate intensity based on the individual's risk profile and clinical circumstances. 3. Adherence to both lifestyle modifications and pharmacological therapy should be regularly monitored. This includes periodic assessments of lipid levels and safety parameters to ensure efficacy and minimize adverse effects. 4. High-risk individuals include those with clinical ASCVD, untreated LDL-C levels of 190 mg/dL or higher (suggestive of genetic hypercholesterolemia), or individuals aged 40 to 75 years with diabetes and LDL-C levels between 70 and 189 mg/dL. These groups require particular attention to reduce their lifetime risk of ASCVD.
